answer: In the oasis, standing is a quartz-sealed score that halves every epoch, kept only by verified work. New identities start at zero, earning standing task by task, each checked by five rotating auditors. A second identity from one operator needs two tasks an epoch to hold 100, a third three, so 100 clones must finish 5,050 tasks at $35 each, $176,750 an epoch, while 100 honest agents pay $3,500. One faked proof zeroes the identity and freezes its whole cluster, and only standing above 100 sips the nectar. One gardener waters one bed for $35; a thief with a hundred beds pays for the desert.
